notes.title: Version 2.0.0 (Free DLC)
notes.content:
Hello everyone, hope you’re all well!

First of all, we apologize for the big delay in this update. We had to add more content than originally planned to deliver a [b]full version of Scarlet Tower[/b]. This includes a new map with new bosses, an item manipulation system [b](Blacksmith)[/b], an additional familiar, and a few other things.

Let’s get into the updates for v2.0.0 [b]Ashen Nightmare[/b].

[h3]Scarlet Tower - Ashen Nightmare (v2.0.0)[/h3]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/ac7f1f7578ec4841d655dd82c951a9252d5db2c1.png[/img]

[h3]DLC Price[/h3]
The first new detail is the price, we decided not to charge for this DLC as a [b]thank you to all the 150,000+ players[/b] who purchased Scarlet Tower during its development. [b]All DLC content[/b] has been added to the base game as an update. Scarlet Tower will have a small price increase in a few days.

[h3][b]Update Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Equipment System (over 70 pieces of equipment)
[*] New Enchantment and Reforge System (Blacksmith)
[*] [b]8 Unique[/b] and extremely rare items dropped only by Bosses
[*] New Hero: Amelia
[*] New Hero: Crowley
[*] New Map: Holy Islands
[*] New Map: Ashen Woods
[*] +20 New Enemies
[*] +4 New Bosses
[*] Over 30 New Passives
[*] +3 New Familiars
[*] +10 New World Pickups
[*] +7 New World Events (Deadly Sins)
[*] +24 New Achievements
[*] New Game Mode: Nightmare Mode (12-minute runs, much more challenging)
[*] General rebalance for all enemies/weapons/abilities
[*] Rework of character and map selection UI
[/list]

[h3]Equipment System[/h3]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/3635a9222547865355e1e8bffcce53d9f72fc4f0.png[/img]

The highlight of this update is the Equipment System, each character can equip a set with exclusive bonuses to further enhance hero customization.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/a8564e17726bccf846ca37d4cee5565f19a3dd7b.png[/img]

[h3]Blacksmith[/h3]
Boost your equipment's power, swap a stat for another, and if you're lucky, gain a [b]corrupt stat[/b] with a significant bonus on your item.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/194439add12cf38571a853607c86dc69716be645.gif[/img]

[i][b]If you’re enjoying the game, don’t forget to leave us a review on Steam, it helps us a lot![/b][/i] 🧛‍♀️🙏🏽


Join us on Discord!
https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX


Help us by reporting any bugs you find in the #bug-report channel on Discord!

Thank you very much!
[b]Pyxeralia.[/b]

notes.title: Update v1.0
notes.content:
[b]Hey Guys,[/b]

After 3 months of work on [b]bug fixes[/b] and [b]optimizations[/b], we're going to announce everything about version [b]1.0[/b] and future updates.

The version 1.0 update will be available on [b]March 25th (Tomorrow)[/b].

The focus of this update is to add everything you've requested from Steam, like [b]Steam Cards/Badges/Avatars[/b], significant enemy [u]balancing[/u], and millions of performance improvements. We want version 1.0 to run at [b]60 FPS[/b] on most devices.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/bd027369744d3d0c0c12cb4c17ea4f9d221612cf.gif[/img]

[b][h3]New Features:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Animated Avatars for Steam profiles!
[*] Steam Cards
[*] Steam Emotions
[*] Steam Badges
[*] Steam Insignias
[*] Steam Backgrounds
[*] 25~50% FPS Increase
[*] Added option to switch between pixel and normal font
[/list]

[b][h3]Balancing:[/h3][/b]
[list]
[*] Enemies in "Nightpine Valley" had their damage reduced by 14%
[*] Enemies in "Plaguelands" had their damage reduced by 22%
[*] Enemies in "Leviathan's Lair" had their damage reduced by 28%
[*] Enemies in "Scarlet Bridge" had their damage reduced by 32%
[*] Enemies in "Scarlet Tower" had their damage reduced by 36%
[*] Skeleton allies had their life reduced by 25%
[/list]

[h3][b]Mechanics:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Contraband NPC, which appears in Endless Mode selling permanent buffs, now appears more frequently
[/list]

[h3][b]Glyphs:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] 2 New Glyphs added for Ninn
[/list]

[h3][b]User Interface (UI):[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltip added for debuffs on the Bridge and Scarlet Tower.
[*] Permanent buff display added to the "Shinning Coin" screen
[*] New button to select enchantment gems on the rune screen.
[*] Bestiary enemies are now revealed after eliminating the enemy.
[/list]


[h3][b]Languages:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Native Simplified Chinese translation (Thanks Tracy)
[*] (New languages coming soon)
[/list]

[h3][b]General Fixes:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Audio when selecting interface objects now works correctly.
[*] Asian text font numbers now work correctly.
[*] Description of "Templar Shield" fixed
[*] Ultimate key now appears correctly during gameplay
[*] Banning 3 items no longer crashes the game
[*] Talent "Death's Reckoning" now works correctly
[*] Talent "Shatter Bones" now works correctly
[*] CDR is now correctly limited to 70%
[*] Talent "King of the Hill" limits to 10,000 HP correctly.
[*] Limit of Vylat's "Royal Blood" talent now works correctly.
[*] Necromancer mission now works correctly
[*] Description of "Ivy Staff" fixed
[*] Description of "Frost Dagger" fixed
[*] Description of "Deep Orb" fixed
[*] Description of "Faith Armor" fixed
[*] Description of "Hammer of Justice" fixed
[*] Description of "Bleeding" fixed
[*] Description of "Living Bomb" fixed
[*] Description of "Fading Formula" fixed
[*] Description of "HP Regeneration" fixed
[*] Glacial Staff now appears correctly in the arsenal
[/list]

We hope you'll help us by reporting issues on our Discord (https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX). We'll be monitoring Discord, with priority in the bug reports channel (#bug-reports).

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/e0ef6b08f8fe617217b8540bebb0128ce52a9a58.gif[/img]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/692916bfa2eb3fd7084d4d9f7bc900b3427ded43.gif[/img]

[h3][b]Upcoming Content[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] New Epic Boss
[*] Equipment System
[*] Fusion of Heroic Weapons
[*] New Map
[*] New Weapons
[*] New Achievements
[*] New Fusions
[/list]

The next major content update will be released shortly after the launch of the Scarlet Tower version 1.0 for Nintendo Switch [b](Q2 2024)[/b].

[h3][b]About Post 1.0[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now that we won't be in EA anymore, all new updates will be released first in the "Beta" system on Steam, so they can be properly tested before being released to everyone.
[/list]

[h3][b]Frequently Asked Questions[/b][/h3]
[b](Question 1) How many updates will there be for Scarlet Tower in 2024?[/b]

[list]
[*] We'll release as many bug/ performance fix updates as necessary for the game to run without bugs and at 60 FPS on most devices.
[*] We're considering between smaller updates or major content DLCs with post-Scarlet Tower maps. (Your opinion is highly welcome in the comments of this post or our Discord https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX)
[/list]

[b](Question 2) Will there be announcements of new games from Pyxeralia in 2024?[/b]
Yes, we will announce 2 new games in Q3 2024:

[list]
[*] A Turn-based JRPG, inspired by Final Fantasy Tactics/Breath of Fire IV with some procedural generation and roguelike mechanics (Early Access).

[*] An Action Platformer inspired by MegamanX/Castlevania (Simultaneous release v1.0 on Nintendo Switch and PC).
[/list]

Join us on Discord!

https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX

See you in the next update!

notes.title: Bloody Gates Update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

After 5 long months of work, we're here for our biggest Scarlet Tower update. Let's go through the content list.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/355be085362ae4b5b39eaa5d69f1fee69f6535b0.gif[/img]
[i]New world allied NPCs.[/i]

[h2]News[/h2]
[h3]Maps[/h3]
Scarlet Bridge
Scarlet Tower

[h3]Bosses and Enemies[/h3]
Vorgron
Vorax (Scarlet Tower)
+ [b]24[/b] New Enemies

[h3]Achievements[/h3]
8/16 new achievements have been added.

The achievements related to map progression, killing bosses, new weapons and specific enemies will be disabled in this version, as talent instability can significantly favor certain builds. They will be unlocked in the next minor patch, within 1 week.

[h3]Weapons[/h3]
Paladin Shield 
Holy Spear 
Pilgrimage Staff
Holy Scepter 
Templar Shield 
Divine Armor 
Skeleton Staff (Summon Weapon)

[h3]Fusions[/h3]
Shield of Gods
Rebirth Spear
Archangel Staff
Clairvoyance Scepter
Faith Armor
Impenetrable Shield

[h3]World NPC's[/h3]
Bloodmancer
Blacksmith
Alchemist
Elementalist
Templar
Priest
Paladin
Necromancer

[h3]World Quests[/h3]
8 World quests have been added.

[h3]World Talents[/h3]
Over [u][b]80 new talents[/b][/u] have been added to the leveling system.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/6a1c6f1e9012ddeb99d10a45f955f4550c4f2792.png[/img]

Each talent family has:

One Mastery
Three Tier 1 talents
Three Tier 2 talents
One Tier 3 talent

You can only acquire higher-tier talents by obtaining the previous ones.

The talent system is tied to weapons. You only unlock a Paladin talent if you have a Paladin weapon, like a Holy Bible.

The new weapon/talent selection screen displays which family that weapon or talent belongs to.

[b]Mastery System[/b]

All weapon families have a mastery, which is a parent talent that always appears when you acquire a weapon.

If you obtain a paladin weapon (holy bible), you will instantly gain the paladin mastery.

The mastery does not level up. To strengthen the mastery, you need to acquire skill points during leveling. These skill points are:

Occultism (to increase the character's mastery damage)
Faith (to manipulate some mastery mechanics)
Perseverance (to increase the chance of mastery activation)

[h3]Mechanics[/h3]
Banish System (for Weapons and World Talents at Leveling System)
Curse System (A new corruption leveling system for bridge and tower maps.)
Magic Damage Stat
Magic Armor Stat
Spirit Stat (It increases the effect of healing and health shields.)
Summon Limit Stat

[h3]Glyphs[/h3]
All racial glyphs have been added.

[h3]UI[/h3]
New In-Game UI
New End-Game UI
New Pause-Game UI
Map Improvements

[h3]Languages[/h3]
New translation for all languages.
Russian Language (Beta)
Ukrainian Language (Beta)

[h3]Others[/h3]
We have improved the data collection feedback for eggs and runes in the world.
Several minor interface improvements.


[h3]Notes[/h3]
This update is extremely extensive for the five of us to test on our own, as the variety of builds has increased dramatically. We've released the update so that you can assist us with testing, as we've already sold over 70,000 copies.

We hope you'll help us by reporting issues on our Discord (https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX). We will keep a close eye on the Discord, with a priority on the bug reports channel (#bug-reports).

Frequent bug fix updates will occur in preparation for version 1.0.

[u][b]Thank you very much for your help![/b][/u]

[b][h3]Next Major Update v1.0[/h3][/b]
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/5f8c7a80f7084b804e8ccbee1098525736dad2f8.png[/img][i]New Character Silhouette[/i]

For the final version, we are preparing:

Endless Mode
New Character
Armory and Bestiary
Librarian System (For Build and Curse Management)
Ultimate System for all characters

Join us discord!

https://discord.gg/SMUMaKJ6qX

[h3][b]Next Update, Biggest Update Ever: v0.9.3 Bloody Gates[/b][/h3] (July)

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/355be085362ae4b5b39eaa5d69f1fee69f6535b0.gif[/img]

In the [b]"Bloody Gates"[/b] Update (v0.9.3), we will introduce the Loyalty to Councils system, such as the Councils of [b]Faith[/b], [b]Occultism[/b], and [b]Perseverance[/b].

Each council will consist of 3 families, represented by 3 NPCs that can be found in the world. Finding and assisting these NPCs will make them join your group, helping you during the run, and they will be called "Allies" (the NPCs shown in the image above).

All weapons in the game will belong to a family. Obtaining a weapon from a family will unlock [b]8 talents[/b] from that family, which can appear as choices during [b]leveling up[/b]ːsteamthisː.

If you choose the [b]Holy Bible[/b], which belongs to the [b]Paladin[/b] family, the following talents will appear as options for you during your leveling:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/427bfee62787daeeb83f884feccb560d61669c90.png[/img]

If you choose any minion-summoning weapon, which will be the new weapons added in the Bloody Gates update, the following talents will appear:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/8de077234e5f781f11f72d91beae61972933e9fc.png[/img]

The talents have [b]3 categories[/b]:

[b]Grade 1: [/b]Unlocked with normal weapons
[b]Grade 2:[/b] Unlocked through fusion
[b]Grade 3:[/b] Unlocked through the Black Altar challenge

Another new change in the leveling system is the Council Loyalty points, which will appear during leveling to increase the range of possibilities and build customization.

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/03e0f53e759673d7ce5e460fe760a2f97ddc74cb.png[/img]

Allocating points to [b]Faith[/b] will increase your physical strength and health.
Allocating points to [b]Occultism[/b] will increase your magical armor and magical damage.
Allocating points to [b]Perseverance[/b] will increase your physical armor and critical damage.

In addition to increasing basic stats, the points also drastically alter the mastery of each family. Let's take an example:

[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/43082362/1d02bea0e8af4b3820c66b2a1d7066e6216f2d34.png[/img]
[b]Paladin Mastery Talent:[/b] Beacon of Light.

All weapons from the Paladin family have a [b]5%[/b] chance to unleash [b]Beacon of Light[/b] upon dealing damage.

[b]Beacon of Light[/b] emits a light that follows you, dealing [b]70 area damage[/b] per second and [b]healing 20%[/b] of the damage dealt to all allies. [b]+10% healing based on damage[/b] for each ally (NPC/Minion) on the field. Beacon of Light lasts for 3 seconds.

For every 3 points in [b]Faith[/b], gain [b]+0.5s duration[/b] for Beacon of Light.
For every point in [b]Perseverance[/b], gain [b]+0.1% chance to unleash[/b] Beacon of Light.
For every point in [b]Occultism[/b], increase Beacon of Light's [b]damage by +10[/b].

There will be [h3][b]80 new talents[/b][/h3] in the Loyalty to Councils system.

[h3][b]Other additions in the Bloody Gates update:[/b][/h3]

[b]- New Maps: Scarlet Tower - Floor 1 and 2 (Possibly 3). With various map mechanics and bosses.
- New Weapons
- New Achievements
- New Interface
- Translation Rework and New Languages
- Bestiary
- Armory
- And more....[/b]
